total_length — 2D features op

• Data kinds: contour → feature

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "total_length", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: length_xld (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

A feature that returns the total arc length of all XLD contours. Equivalent to HALCON's `length_xld` (Length of contours or polygons.).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

`a, b` は未使用。各輪郭について隣接点間のユークリッド距離を足し合わせたもの（折れ線の全長）を、全輪郭ぶん合算する。点が 2 点未満の輪郭は長さ 0 として扱われる。
